subject: general
question:
The graph and the table below show the units sold by two salesmen, Mr. P and Mr. Q, in 4 months from January to April. Study the graph and the table and answer the question

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f0dea3e1427ecd2d07ca0f29e7ba675aba93b87658b10dd84c0627bbff99ae4.png] 

What is the respective ratio of the total units sold by Mr. P and Mr. Q during the 4 months?
solution:
**Calculation:**

⇒ Total units sold by Mr. P = 80 + 30 + 50 + 90

⇒ Total units sold by Mr. P = 250

⇒ Total units sold by Mr. Q = 60 + 40 + 70 + 60

⇒ Total units sold by Mr. Q = 230

⇒ Ratio of units sold by Mr. P to Mr. Q = Total units sold by Mr. P / Total units sold by Mr. Q

⇒ Ratio = 250 / 230

⇒ Ratio = 25 / 23

**∴ The respective ratio of the total units sold by Mr. P and Mr. Q during the 4 months is 25 : 23.**
